name: ubahn-tv
description: Passenger TV in a side pane while Claude works: Podsumo episode cards and Nuremberg's U-Bahn (regiofokus.de) by default, or any Media RSS feeds

feeds.title: Feeds
feeds.description: Feed URLs to play, mixed into one loop, separated by spaces or commas: regiofokus.de playlist.json addresses or Media RSS feeds

auto_open_delay_seconds.title: Auto-open delay (seconds)
auto_open_delay_seconds.description: How long a turn runs before the pane opens by itself; 0 opens it at once

fps.title: Frames per second
fps.description: Playback frame rate; higher is smoother and uses more disk for decoded frames

desktop_fps.title: Desktop stills per second
desktop_fps.description: The Desktop app shows stills instead of video; more per second is smoother and sends more data per second

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: hybrid: smooth, catches up when a busy turn delays it; ticks: one frame per timer tick; wall: exact clock, may skip frames

verbose_log.title: Verbose debug log
verbose_log.description: Log every tick and frame to the debug log (claude --debug-file <path>)
